integrity: Symbolic proof given; finite Python checks are not general certification. Foundational edge-ring presentation and normality criterion are established prior art.
scientific_limitations: Characteristic zero, two vertex-disjoint odd cycles and one connecting path; not general graph edge varieties.
Only the reduced Jacobian singular scheme is classified; the full nonreduced Jacobian scheme and conductor remain open here.
Generic transverse models only; no classification of strata intersections.
Possible implicit equivalent treatment in broader graph-normalization literature remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Complete singular-stratum and Hilbert-series laws for odd-cycle dumbbell edge hypersurfaces
